classification: Explicit research assumptions adapted from Toolkit Open; no supplier, foundry or measured-device qualification
source: Retained native ResearchOpen substrate, material database, exported proj.ltd and actual generated proj.sub
interpretation: The original contract table lists nominal dielectric inputs. ADS EXPAND_UP also adds the mapped conductor thicknesses, including inactive process layers. This record preserves and describes the actual simulated background rather than silently substituting the nominal sum.

equivalence_requirement: Canonicalization may merge only identical, unoccupied dielectric interfaces. Preserve the complete complex background profile, both active conductor faces, physical masks 7/35 and open AIR halfspaces. Generated profiles and complete complex S must be independently checked.
